text:
simon: quick q — we upgraded a chart and now the pod env var from a secret is empty. values.yaml has:

```yaml
env:
  - name: FEATURE_FLAG
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: myapp-secrets
        key: feature_flag
```

and the template is basically: 

```gotmpl
- name: {{ .name }}
  {{- if .Values.env }}
  {{ toYaml .Values.env | nindent 8 }}
  {{- end }}
```

But after helm upgrade the generated manifest drops the `valueFrom` block entirely (no value, no secret). Anyone seen this?

olivia: hmm usually that happens when .Values.env is an array but the chart expects a map or vice versa. Are you passing env as a list in values?

simon: yes it's a list (we used the old chart which flattened it). I expected `toYaml` to preserve it. Helm lint passes but K8s API rejects since key missing.

devon: fyi `toYaml` will output whatever you give it, but indentation/context matters. If your outer template is building a list it can produce invalid YAML if you forget the `-` or nindent level. Can you paste the parent block?

simon: parent is `env:` in the container spec, like:

```gotmpl
containers:
  - name: app
    image: {{ .Values.image }}
    env:
{{- if .Values.env }}
{{ toYaml .Values.env | indent 6 }}
{{- end }}
```

olivia: try `nindent 8` instead of `indent 6` so it lines up under `env:` (two spaces for YAML list). Also make sure the list items already include the `-` in values.yaml. Example values should be a list, not a map: 

```yaml
env:
  - name: FEATURE_FLAG
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: myapp-secrets
        key: feature_flag
```

devon: alternatively if you want to reference a single secret key via values (e.g., just give the secret name in values) change template to render `valueFrom` only when name present: 

```gotmpl
- name: FEATURE_FLAG
  {{- if .Values.secrets.feature_flag_name }}
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: {{ .Values.secrets.feature_flag_name }}
      key: feature_flag
  {{- else }}
  value: "{{ default \"false\" .Values.defaults.feature_flag }}"
  {{- end }}
```

maria: we have a small PR for this: https://git.rd/w/PR-3421 — changed indent and added a unit test for helm template output. CI failed though — see deploy-bot below. can someone review?

deploy-bot: CI: helm template lint failed on chart myapp: error converting YAML to JSON: yaml: line 24: mapping values are not allowed here (chart/myapp/templates/deployment.yaml:24) :red_circle:

tyler: that error usually means a stray `:` or wrong indentation. I can take a look in 30m. Quick tip: run `helm template . --values test/values.yaml | yq e -P` locally to catch the formatting before CI.

olivia: also consider switching to `envFrom` if you just want to mount all keys from a secret: 

```yaml
envFrom:
  - secretRef:
      name: myapp-secrets
```

but note envFrom can't map a single key to a single env var, it's whole-secret -> multiple env vars.

simon: thanks all — i'll adjust the template to use `nindent` and add the conditional fallback and push a fix to PR-3421. pinging @maria for review when ready. :thumbsup:
